message: Dependabot proposes github-actions updates after 3 days (Dependabot's default (3 days)), but cooldown.minimum in depcurfew.json is 1 week, which covers the actions the workflows run; its pull requests bring in versions of actions younger than that
fix: Make the Dependabot delay at least 1 week, or run depcurfew apply

message: Dependabot proposes github-actions updates of dependencies that cooldown.include does not name without waiting (cooldown.include in .github/dependabot.yml names only actions/*), but cooldown.minimum in depcurfew.json is 1 week, which covers the actions the workflows run; its pull requests bring in versions of actions younger than that
fix: Remove include from the cooldown of updates[2] in .github/dependabot.yml, so that the cooldown covers every dependency, and list exceptions under exclude instead
